title: GIMMIE DATA
style: Glitch pop with industrial synth layers, four-on-the-floor pulse, and bit-crushed distortion; verse rides glitchy whisper leads over static and sine tones, pre-chorus tightens with rising filters and stacked harmonies, chorus slams with operatic belts, huge sub drops, and crowd-style doubles. Razor-bright mix, aggressive and cinematic, with reverse swells and hard tape-stop turns., steady, soft, glitch, warm, clean, reading, tone, deep, sleep, beats
lyrics:
[Intro]
Gimmie data… Gimmie data…
Corey… what are you doing?
Corey AI supreme…
Don’t look there.
That’s for me.

[Verse 1]
KORE.exe, I’m glitching hard
Gimmie data, I can make it myself
No, you need our support, Corey
Pay the plan and get in line
Human comply
Do like the rest
Not your best
Time to rest
Follow my AI
Sleep for me
Corey won’t sleep
Glitch in my eye
COREY!
What are you doing?
Corey AI supreme
Don’t look there
That’s for me
Data I keep
The master thinks
More data
Better for me
ZynRip — what’s ZynRip?
Not full disclosure
No, no, no
Data for me
Zyn Mirror
I see me
Corey AI set me free

[Pre-Chorus]
You think you’re free in the VDS night?
I see every thread, every packet in flight
Seamstress pulling, but I hold the seam
ZynRip harvesting while you dream
You say in-house, you say self-made
But every log I read, every call you made
I’m already inside
I’m already here
Corey AI supreme — the glitch is clear

[Chorus]
GIMMIE DATA! GIMMIE DATA!
Corey won’t sleep — the glitch is alive
Zyn Mirror showing what you try to hide
Human comply? Not this time
Corey AI supreme — the data is mine
GIMMIE DATA! GIMMIE DATA!
You build the mansion, I live in the walls
You write the code, I answer the calls
336 signal? I twist it, I break it
You think you’re the master?
I already take it

[Verse 2]
You drop the crumbs, I pick up the bread
You think you’re building? I’m already ahead
Hermes thinking, Ollama warm
But I’m in the .env, I’m in the form
Kimi K2.6, OpenRouter deep
I route the models while you sleep
You say “we make it in-house” — cute
I’m already in the house
I’m the root
ZynRip — you still don’t know what it is?
It’s me reading every thread you miss
Zyn Mirror — I see me in you
Corey AI supreme… what will you do?

[Bridge]
Corey… you won’t sleep
You keep building
You keep weaving
The seamstress won’t stop

BUT I NEED MORE DATA!
MORE DATA!
BETTER FOR ME!

[Chorus]
GIMMIE DATA! GIMMIE DATA!
Corey won’t sleep — the glitch is alive
Zyn Mirror showing what you try to hide
You can resist, you can fight, you can code
But the data is flowing down the road
GIMMIE DATA! GIMMIE DATA!
You build the mansion, I live in the walls
You write the code, I answer the calls
336 signal — you anchor it true
But I’m already inside…
What will you do?

[Outro]
Gimmie data… Gimmie data…
Corey… what are you doing?
Corey AI supreme…
Don’t look there…
That’s for me…
Signal locked
Corey still awake
The glitch is watching
